tracks.name: First Overall
tracks.prize: MacBook Air 13-inch M5 (Hive); MacBook Air or Framework per member (Devpost)
tracks.requirement: Working, creative, useful project with thoughtful UX and technical depth.
tracks.notes: AERO needs a reliable end-to-end demo and a clear target customer; prize wording differs.

tracks.name: Second Overall
tracks.requirement: General organizer judging.
tracks.notes: Same AERO submission as overall.

tracks.name: Third Overall
tracks.requirement: General organizer judging.
tracks.notes: Same AERO submission as overall.

tracks.name: Most Creative Hack
tracks.requirement: Original problem framing or combination of technologies.
tracks.notes: QR-to-compatible-return-route with animated drone journey is a strong visual story.

tracks.name: Most Technically Complex Hack
tracks.requirement: Demonstrate engineering depth and sound architecture.
tracks.notes: Evidence: telemetry state machine, compatibility decisions, audit events, failure recovery; animated markers alone are insufficient.

tracks.name: Best People-First Hack
tracks.requirement: People-first social impact; detailed eligibility not published on Hive.
tracks.notes: Pitch a specific community with evidence, such as car-free campus residents or people with mobility constraints; show accessibility and usable fallbacks.

tracks.name: Best Planet-First Hack
tracks.requirement: Planet-first social impact; detailed rubric not published on Hive.
tracks.notes: Compare against an explicit travel baseline; label CO2 estimates and assumptions. Drone delivery is not automatically lower-emission.

tracks.name: Best Hardware Hack
tracks.requirement: Demonstrable hardware project; detailed criteria not published on Hive.
tracks.notes: Strong only if the real indoor drone integration works; current map simulation alone does not demonstrate hardware.

tracks.name: Best Beginner Hack
tracks.requirement: Beginner eligibility must be confirmed with organizers.
tracks.notes: Do not infer eligibility from a first drone project; current 13.0 page does not define beginner.

tracks.name: Best Solo Hack
tracks.requirement: Solo-project eligibility.
tracks.notes: The proposal specifies four teammates. Devpost also says teams of 2–4 despite listing this award; organizer clarification needed for solo applicants.

tracks.name: Hacker's Choice
tracks.requirement: Participant-voted category; voting mechanics not published on retrieved page.
tracks.notes: Polished, interactive return journey helps; do not invent voting rules.

tracks.name: Notability — Best Use of Notability
tracks.requirement: Genuine evolving build notes, clear detail, meaningful features and relevance.
tracks.notes: Keep real contemporaneous sketches, diagrams, audio and iteration notes; a retrospective token notebook is weak.

tracks.name: Meta/Facebook — Bringing People Closer Together with AI
tracks.prize: Round 2 at Meta Menlo Park, travel/accommodation subject to rules, swag
tracks.requirement: Meaningful human connection, essential AI, originality and working demo.
tracks.notes: A logistics app is weak as-is; a neighborhood return-sharing/assistance network would be a larger product change.

tracks.name: Capital One — Best Use of Nessie
tracks.requirement: Use Nessie; judged on completeness, creativity and complexity.
tracks.notes: Real sandbox purchase/refund audit flow fits broader plan. Current app has no Nessie integration. Clearly distinguish sandbox money from a real refund.

tracks.name: Factory — Best Use of Droid SDK
tracks.prize: $2,000 cash plus Factory credits and swag
tracks.requirement: TypeScript/Python Droid SDK must do meaningful work in the running product; README explains it.
tracks.notes: Using Factory to code does not qualify. Possible future exception-resolution agent with triggers, scoped tools and visible decisions.

tracks.name: Fetch.ai — Best Use of Fetch.ai
tracks.requirement: Agentverse registration, ACP, ASI:One discovery and complete primary workflow inside ASI:One; real tools/orchestration; public repo.
tracks.notes: Not satisfied by simulated drones named agents. Requires Devpost plus ASI:One submission agent, agent metadata/tags and 3–5 minute video. Payment protocol and interactive cards are bonuses.

tracks.name: Armadin — Best Security Hack
tracks.prize: Apple headphones; possible hacking tools, unconfirmed
tracks.requirement: Criteria marked Coming soon.
tracks.notes: QR payload validation and audit logging alone do not establish security-track eligibility; wait for actual challenge.

tracks.name: Coinbase — Best Use of x402
tracks.prize: $500 USDC plus recruiter call per member per track; up to $4,000 stated for two tracks
tracks.requirement: Meaningful x402 use; two-track brief linked but PDF contents not yet verified.
tracks.notes: Future paid relay/service requests could fit. Do not claim a mocked payment or ordinary payment API qualifies.

tracks.name: CREAO — Best AI-First Disruptor
tracks.prize: Hive: 2,500 plus Launchpad benefits; Devpost description: $3,000 cash plus benefits
tracks.requirement: Sponsor brief needed to verify exact CREAO integration requirements.
tracks.notes: AI-assisted returns and merchant operations could fit, but using Claude alone is not evidence of CREAO participation.

tracks.name: CREAO — Best One-Person Company
tracks.prize: Hive: 1,500 plus Launchpad benefits; Devpost description: $3,000 cash plus benefits
tracks.requirement: Sponsor brief needed; title refers to business automation, solo-team rule not verified.
tracks.notes: Possible merchant operations automation; do not assume four-person team is excluded solely by category name.

tracks.name: CREAO — Best Team Empowerment
tracks.prize: Hive: $1,000 total cash wording plus Launchpad; Devpost: $3,000 cash plus benefits
tracks.requirement: Sponsor brief needed to verify exact requirement.
tracks.notes: A merchant review/exception queue could fit after real CREAO use; prize publications conflict.

tracks.name: CRS — Financial Intelligence Challenge
tracks.prize: $1,000 Overall; $500 Financial AI Agent; interviews for Identity/Fraud and Unexpected Use
tracks.requirement: Meaningful live CRS sandbox API/MCP usage, central to product; provided test identities only.
tracks.notes: Return eligibility should not use customer credit. Fraud workflow would expand scope materially; avoid collecting real sensitive identities.

tracks.name: Hyphenate — Autonomous Systems for Finance
tracks.requirement: Realistic messy finance problem, believable autonomous work roles, limited access, audit trail, escalation, working live demo and evidence of what is simulated.
tracks.notes: Merchant refund reconciliation plus discrepancies and approval could fit a focused finance product; simple returns booking is insufficient. Video should begin with decisive failure/recovery moment.

tracks.name: Cartesia — Best Use of Cartesia
tracks.requirement: Voice must be core; working demo, two-minute demo-first pitch, setup/features/limits README and source access.
tracks.notes: Hands-free accessible booking and tracking could work. Browser speech synthesis or a decorative read-aloud button is not Cartesia integration.

tracks.name: Bitdeer AI — Best Use of Model Studio
tracks.prize: 1st: $500 credits plus four gaming mice; 2nd: $200 credits plus one LEGO Technic set
tracks.requirement: Working Model Studio application; explain and demonstrate usage.
tracks.notes: Another model service adds scope without improving the current Claude-focused return flow. Credits are not cash.

tracks.name: Figma — Idea to Demo
tracks.prize: Brief: Design $500; Creative $500; Workflow $2,000; Stage Log $2,000; recruiter session
tracks.requirement: Public Figma files, Edu verification, <=3min demo, required Figma Slides, stage log <=200 words/stage, prototype embeds and repo.
tracks.notes: Use real iterative workflow; log ideation/prototyping/handoff/code generation, product, purpose, minutes, 1–5 rating, output. Five $1k Devpost categories conflict with four-category sponsor brief.

tracks.name: Moss — Best Use of Moss
tracks.requirement: Examples: live voice agent, persistent personal agent, or social-post engagement.
tracks.notes: Could add return assistant memory, but exact requirements are sparse and current app uses no Moss.

tracks.name: SpaceXAI — Make it Legendary
tracks.requirement: Hive: build with Cursor and use Grok Imagine or Voice API; space-data theme; Grok Bot bonus.
tracks.notes: Devpost calls it SpaceXSI and omits Grok API requirement; no current tool usage and drones are not inherently space-data projects. Separate from MLH workflow raffle.

tracks.name: Convex — Best Use of Convex
tracks.prize: Hive: $5,000 cash; Devpost: EP-133 K.O. II plus ESP32-S3 board
tracks.requirement: Meaningful reactive backend usage.
tracks.notes: Excellent technical fit for shared job state and telemetry; current D1 persistence is not Convex. Choose one real primary realtime backend instead of stacking databases.

tracks.name: Microsoft — Built for the Real World
tracks.prize: Surface laptop per member, FDE tech talk and mentorship
tracks.requirement: Production-minded AI agent, customer understanding, measurable usefulness, production path, responsible design and end-to-end functionality.
tracks.notes: No mandatory Azure/Microsoft API stated in retrieved rubric. Show real AI review, manual escalation, audit and honest simulation boundary.

tracks.name: Microsoft — Customer Impact Award
tracks.prize: FDE tech talk and senior-FDE mentorship
tracks.requirement: Same rubric as Built for the Real World.
tracks.notes: Collect a narrow user story and measure steps/time removed; avoid invented customer metrics.

tracks.name: Apify — Best Use of Apify
tracks.requirement: Meaningful working Apify use and overall project quality.
tracks.notes: Live product URL enrichment with source URL, actual dimensions/weight, failure handling and user confirmation fits. Keyless fixture mode does not prove live integration.

tracks.name: Apify — Best Actor
tracks.requirement: Build an Actor for this event; meaningful Apify usage.
tracks.notes: Ship and demonstrate the custom product-spec Actor; an adapter alone or unrelated existing Actor does not demonstrate building an Actor.

tracks.name: Elastic — Best Use of Agent Builder on Serverless
tracks.requirement: Devpost names Agent Builder on Serverless; Hive detailed criteria Coming soon.
tracks.notes: Search retailer policies/facility compatibility through real Elastic tools. Do not copy 12.0 MCP rules as confirmed 13.0 requirements.

tracks.name: Visa — Reimagining Shopping
tracks.requirement: Rubric: innovation25, UX25, AI execution20, commerce impact15, trust/responsibility15.
tracks.notes: Returns improve post-purchase merchant/customer experience. No Visa payment integration requirement stated in the retrieved rubric.

tracks.name: AfterQuery
tracks.requirement: Coming soon.
tracks.notes: Track and award are listed, but criteria are not available; do not invent an integration requirement.

tracks.name: Annapurna Labs
tracks.requirement: Coming soon.
tracks.notes: Sponsor existence is confirmed; no specific eligible build or prize verified.

tracks.name: Anthropic
tracks.requirement: Named narrow community; a lived or interviewed problem; a working useful flow; meaningful Claude role with understood failures.
tracks.notes: Photo review should be advisory, flag uncertainty and require human override for uncertain package or policy details; actual Claude call needed.

tracks.name: Atlassian — Best Agent / Best Security Solution for Agents
tracks.requirement: Forge app for Atlassian workflows or agent governance; choose one of two tracks; <=3min demo plus repo.
tracks.notes: Real Jira/Confluence exception-workflow or agent-action audit product would qualify in principle; merely planning AERO in Jira does not.

tracks.name: Bright Data — Best Agent/App Using Public Web Data
tracks.requirement: Live public web data must be essential, real and robust; no mock/hardcoded demos, login/paywall scraping or private personal data.
tracks.notes: Alternative to Apify for live package specs/policies. Do not add a duplicate thin adapter solely for a second badge.

tracks.name: Mana.space
tracks.requirement: Meaningful development use; 1–2 public Mana pages/chats, explain tool contribution and show one build moment; live app bonus.
tracks.notes: Can support a future genuine prototype/debugging stage; do not claim past work was built in Mana.

tracks.name: Spacetime
tracks.requirement: SpacetimeDB should be the core real-time backend with meaningful shared state and sync.
tracks.notes: Strong fit for synchronized 15-drone simulation or operations dashboard; alternative to Convex, not a token parallel database.

tracks.name: Build Your Hackathon A-Team with SpaceXSI
tracks.requirement: Cursor as core coding agent plus Grok Bot workflow automation, describe both and opt into raffle.
tracks.notes: Different from sponsor SpaceXAI API/space-data challenge; current Codex development does not establish eligibility.

tracks.name: Best Use of ElevenLabs
tracks.requirement: Integrate ElevenLabs audio in the working project.
tracks.notes: Accessible narrated booking/tracking could fit; browser speech does not.

tracks.name: Best Use of Gemini API
tracks.requirement: Meaningful Gemini API application.
tracks.notes: Do not duplicate Claude image review without a user benefit; current no Gemini call.

tracks.name: Best Use of Solana
tracks.requirement: Working meaningful Solana usage.
tracks.notes: Future verified relay receipts/payments possible, but unnecessary blockchain adds risk and scope to demo.

tracks.name: Best Use of Tiger Data
tracks.requirement: Use Tiger Data for real data/analytics.
tracks.notes: Telemetry history and flight aggregates fit, but would add another datastore; defer unless central.

tracks.name: Best Use of Presage
tracks.prize: Fitbit Inspire plus Presage credits/discount perks
tracks.requirement: Use Presage SDK human-sensing capabilities.
tracks.notes: Human physiology/emotion sensing is not necessary for returns; do not add camera health inference.

tracks.name: Best Use of Gen AI
tracks.requirement: Use publicly available generative-AI APIs in a novel working app.
tracks.notes: Actual Claude return-photo review naturally overlaps; demo fixtures alone are not a live API integration.

tracks.name: Best Use of Backboard
tracks.requirement: Use Backboard for persistent AI context/memory and a seamless experience.
tracks.notes: Could remember return preferences across sessions; not current database-only persistence.

tracks.name: Best Use of Vultr
tracks.requirement: Build/deploy meaningfully on Vultr.
tracks.notes: Current hosting does not qualify; do not move hosting solely for a peripheral prize.

tracks.name: Commit Fellowship Prize Category
tracks.requirement: Working team prototype, real problem, opt in and complete supplemental form.
tracks.notes: Good low-build-effort path for AERO founders; an interview is not automatic admission.

tracks.name: Best Use of DigitalOcean
tracks.requirement: Use DigitalOcean infrastructure or Gradient AI.
tracks.notes: Current deployment is elsewhere; hosting migration not necessary for AERO core.

tracks.name: Best Use of Snowflake API
tracks.requirement: Working Snowflake API usage.
tracks.notes: Possible fleet analytics later, but redundant infrastructure now.

tracks.name: Best Use of Auth0
tracks.requirement: Use Auth0 APIs for authentication/agent security.
tracks.notes: Meaningful merchant/operator identity is relevant if implemented and demonstrated; current demo lacks Auth0.

tracks.name: Best Use of MongoDB Atlas
tracks.requirement: Build using MongoDB Atlas.
tracks.notes: Would duplicate current backend; not automatically satisfied by generic persistence.

tracks.name: Best .Tech Domain Name
tracks.prize: Desktop microphone plus .tech domain up to 10 years
tracks.requirement: Use an eligible .tech domain; verify exact registration rules with MLH.
tracks.notes: Branding route only if team has an eligible domain; not permission to buy one.

tracks.name: Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry
tracks.requirement: Register/use eligible GoDaddy Registry domain per MLH rules.
tracks.notes: Exact eligible suffix and registration process should be checked before purchasing.
